Chapter 6471: I Should Warm Up

Chapter 6471: I Should Warm Up

“Boom!” Skyraiser somehow obtained another dramatic boost to overwhelm Alch-deer’s lord state.

When all of Paragon empowered him, everyone felt the spring of Paragon being inside him.

“Bam!” It was Alch-deer’s time to stagger backward with his inner organs trembling.

Spectators became alarmed since Alch-deer was the strongest in Gold Village.

“So is he the lord of Paragon?” Goldblade murmured.

Ocean-gaze assessed the attacker and shook his head: “No, at the supreme lord stage here, he would be the same as a supreme overlord in the real world.”

“You are the highest existence in Gold Village?” Skyraiser looked down on Alch-deer, acting like Paragon was superior to Gold Village.

“I am not.” Alch-deer said.

“Whoever hurt my wife, it is time to come out and accept death.” Skyraiser said with lightning in his eyes.

Although everyone was annoyed at his overbearing attitude, they stood no chance against him. Only Alch-deer was a qualified combatant but still couldn’t win.

“Must have been your group.” Skyraiser turned his attention back to Alch-deer and Ocean-gaze.

The two said nothing and glanced at Li Qiye who was relaxing in his chair again.

“You?” He frowned after being unable to gauge Li Qiye’s cultivation.

“Be careful!” Earthsplitter warned him while being in recovery mode.

His paragon aura erupted after receiving confirmation.

Li Qiye yawned and said: “I’m still waiting for their response on how they want to die.”

“You deserve death.” Skyraiser became violent and spewed out lightning bolts.

They blotted out the sky, some thick enough to pierce through Gold Village.

“Come meet your maker.” He adored his wife, hence the invasion after noticing her injuries.

“Looks like it will be one fewer trip for me since you’re here.” Li Qiye smiled and stood up.

“Take this, brat!” Skyraiser thought about how his wife was beaten by this brat and couldn’t stay calm.

“Paragon Lightning!” He roared and swung his hammer toward Li Qiye, employing both raw physical prowess and the lightning affinity.

When the hammer struck Li Qiye, the resulting blast blinded everyone. Once they could open their eyes, they saw Li Qiye stopping the hammer with one hand.

Skyraiser was shocked but couldn’t pull back in time.

“Bam!” Li Qiye added a bit of strength and crushed the hammer to the opponent’s horror.

“Okay, time for me to warm up. Won’t appear without my interference, I see.” Li Qiye said with a smile.

“God Augmentation!” Skyraiser didn’t have time to think and called for more help.

The gods of his kingdoms roared in response. The descending shockwaves could flatten Octagon.

“Watch it!” Alch-deer and the others used their golden power to protect the region.

Meanwhile, the gods above flew together and fused with Skyraiser. He became massive and confident.

“I am Paragon!” He let out a battle cry.
